title: jung-kurt/gofpdf
notes: gofpdf.New("P", "pt", "A4", ""), SetFont("Helvetica", "", 10); per page AddPage(), Text(x, y, tr(text)) for each text, where tr is UnicodeTranslatorFromDescriptor("") (UTF-8 to cp1252, made per document), and Line for each rule (gofpdf measures from the top-left corner, as the input does); Output to a buffer; returns the bytes. Default settings (compression on). The module is archived; its last release is used.
